courses.name: German University Preparatory Programme (GAPP)
courses.summary: Prepare for engineering study at Universities of Applied Sciences in Germany.
courses.description: A 3-in-1 preparatory programme launched in 2001, combining Cambridge A-Levels, certified German language and a pre-study technical internship, for students who want to study engineering at a University of Applied Sciences in Germany.
courses.duration: 20 months at GMI, then 6 months of intensive German in Germany
courses.fee: RM42,400 tuition for 4 semesters for Malaysian students. RM52,000 with miscellaneous and examination fees, and RM55,600 with optional hostel. Fees are subject to change.
coreAreas: German language certification (TELC, levels A2 to C1)
progression: Apply to any University of Applied Sciences (Hochschule) in Germany

subjectGroups.label: 6 months at language centres in Germany

courses.name: GMI-UTP Foundation Programme (GUFP)
courses.summary: A one-year foundation that qualifies you to start a degree at UTP.
courses.description: A one-year Engineering and Science foundation run with Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS and based on UTP's foundation syllabus. It is taught in English, with weekly German classes. Completing it qualifies students to start an undergraduate programme at UTP.
courses.fee: RM16,050 tuition for Malaysian students. RM18,100 with miscellaneous fees, and RM20,500 with optional hostel. Fees are subject to change.
coreAreas: Introduction to German language and culture
progression: Bachelor's degrees with Honours at UTP in Chemical, Civil, Electrical & Electronics, Integrated, Mechanical, Petroleum, Computer and Material Engineering
BSc (Hons) at UTP in Applied Physics, Applied Chemistry and Petroleum Geoscience
BSc at UTP in Industrial Physics

routes.requirement: Pass SPM or an equivalent qualification with at least a credit in 3 subjects: Mathematics, 1 Science/Technical/Vocational subject and 1 other subject, and a pass in English.
Pass O-Level with at least Grade C in 3 subjects, including Mathematics, 1 Science/Technical/Vocational subject and 1 other subject, and a pass in English.
Pass UEC with at least Grade B in 3 subjects, including Mathematics, 1 subject related to Science/Technical/Vocational and 1 other subject from any field, and a pass in English.
Pass STPM with at least 1 principal in any subject, and pass Mathematics, English and 1 other subject at SPM level.
Pass a Certificate in a related field from a Higher Education Provider recognised by the Government of Malaysia, with a minimum CGPA of 2.00.

Pass a Technical and Vocational Certificate or Skills Certificate in a related field, with 1 year of relevant work experience or at least 1 semester of a bridging programme, and pass SPM with at least 1 credit. SKM must be at Level 3.
Pass Pre-Diploma or Matriculation in a related field with a minimum CGPA of 2.00, pass SPM with at least 3 credits including Bahasa Melayu and 2 other subjects, and pass English.
APEL.A T-4 and appropriate experience as determined by the institution.
Other qualifications recognised as equivalent by the Government of Malaysia.

notes: SVM holders also need at least C in BM 1104, a pass in Sejarah 1251, at least 3 credits in vocational subjects equivalent to SPM electives, a minimum CGPA of 2.00 (Academic) and 2.67 (Vocational), and competency in all vocational modules.
International students need TOEFL 500, IELTS 5.0 or equivalent.
No physical disabilities that would hinder practical work and no colour blindness. Applicants must pass a medical examination and urine test.

Pass GCE A-Level with at least 9 points, or the IB Diploma with at least 24 points, and pass SPM with a credit in Bahasa Melayu and a pass in Sejarah.
